# Labels Back for 2026.11

Version 0.12.1 keeps the visual editor readable on Home Assistant 2026.11 and explains why an event entity only ever shows one item.

## The editor

- **Every switch has its label again.** Home Assistant 2026.11 removes the component the editor used to label its switches, so all ten switches would have stood there without text. The labels now use Home Assistant's own way of labelling a switch: the switch stays in front of its text, and a click on the text toggles it.
- **A hint for event entities.** _[#61]_ The event entity of the core Feedreader integration only holds the newest entry, so the card can never show more than one item for it. The editor now says so as soon as you pick an event entity and points to a feedparser sensor, which keeps the whole feed. The README explains the difference under "Sensor or event entity?".

Dependencies are updated.

## Requirements

The card now needs Home Assistant 2026.5 or newer, up from 2026.4. The card picker suggestion still needs 2026.6. Older installations keep being offered 0.12.0.

Thanks to @dddunst for the report.
